data.body_html:
Planning an Estepona boat rental snorkeling gear 2039 trip? You are in for crystal-clear Mediterranean waters, hidden coves, and a fleet of well-equipped boats from Puerto Banús. Every charter includes snorkeling masks, fins, and snorkels, plus a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on a Tier A boat, or €4,719 for 4 hours on a Tier B Mangusta 80 with a free jet ski. Below, we cover the best gear, boats, and spots for your 2039 snorkeling adventure.

What Snorkeling Gear Comes with Your Estepona Boat Rental?

All 16 boats in our fleet – from the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) to the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – include snorkeling gear as standard. You get full-face or traditional masks, snorkels, and adjustable fins. Life vests are available for non-swimmers. The gear is cleaned and sanitised before every charter. If you have a prescription mask or prefer your own, feel free to bring it.

Best Boats for Snorkeling Near Estepona

For larger groups (up to 12 pax), the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) and Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offer wide swim platforms and easy water access. For smaller parties, the Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) is nimble and can reach shallow coves quickly. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, about 15 nautical miles east of Estepona – a 30-minute cruise each way.

Top Snorkeling Spots Accessible from Estepona

  • Cala del Faro – Rocky reefs with bream, sea bass, and octopus. Depth: 3–8m. 20 mins from Puerto Banús.
  • Cala Cortés – Sandy bottom, calm waters, ideal for beginners. Depth: 2–5m. 25 mins.
  • Cabopino – Seagrass meadows near the marina. Look for starfish and small rays. Depth: 2–6m. 15 mins.
  • La Concha cliffs – Deeper water (10–15m) for experienced snorkelers. 30 mins.

Why 2039 Water Temperatures Favour Snorkeling

Sea surface temperatures near Estepona in 2039 are projected to average 22°C from July to September, with spring and autumn ranging 16–20°C. A thin 3mm wetsuit is comfortable in cooler months, but summer snorkelers can go without. Visibility typically exceeds 15 metres in the coves mentioned above.

Booking Tips for Your Estepona Snorkeling Trip

  • Book at least 2 weeks in advance for summer 2039 – demand is high.
  • Choose a morning departure (9:00–10:00) for calmest sea conditions.
  • Bring reef-safe sunscreen to protect marine life.
  • Ask your skipper to adjust the itinerary based on wind and swell.
